title: Hinomori Shiho — An Autumn Breeze At Sunset〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: Vineyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Every type of grape they had was so good!
I don't think I've ever had so many at once before♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me neither! I believe we all had a splendid time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I also had a lot of fun.
Especially how we got to chat and laugh so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start heading over to see the leaves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Huh?!
What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, we forgot to do something very important!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Shizuku's right!
Look over there!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Over where...?
Are you talking about the souvenir stand?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have a bit of a hike ahead of us, so I think we should start making our way over to see the leaves now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, Shiho, wait!
Please let us look at the souvenirs! We beg you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine, I guess we're not in that much of a hurry. We can briefly stop by that souvenir stand...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shii!
Thanks, Shiho!
Thank you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to do some souvenir shopping!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Look, Shiho!
They're giving out free juice and jelly samples!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you just ate a ton of grapes. You're still hungry?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I might buy some for Airi and the others.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They have cookies made using grapes, as well as sandwich cookies with grape cream filling. But this all-natural grape juice is also very appealing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, wait. Nene would like that, but Emu and Rui might want something a little different. Such as...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's getting Otori something...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then, I should try to avoid buying the same thing as him. What if I...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho! I've picked out souvenirs for everybody!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm getting Miku this! And these are for Rin!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
For each person?
Lemme see... Sandwich cookies for Miku, and Rin's getting... Warabimochi?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yup♪ I wanna know what they taste like!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa, you scared me...!
I didn't realize you'd come back, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe, Sakki told me that you guys were picking our souvenirs♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that just leaves Mom and Dad!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll be right back, Shizuku, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, have fun.
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, why don't we also choose some gifts for our family?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.
se_walk_women_003_2
se_walk_women_003_3

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Since they'll be getting them right when we get home, we can probably buy something with a short shelf life.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You and Saki are gifting the grapes we just picked to your friends, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but it's gonna be a lot to carry.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That shouldn't be a problem.
We can have everything delivered from here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, they actually do that?
Good eye.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Tsukasa and I asked one of the clerks about what we could do, since we're going leaf-viewing after this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you did...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! So, please feel free to buy as much as you like♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That doesn't really mean I can splurge, but I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, you wanna give Mom and Dad some of these grapes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I thought that we could get them some types that you don't normally find at the supermarket.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As it turns out, you get a discount if you buy several different types of grapes as a set.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did the clerk also tell you guys that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then, why not take that deal?
Let's put together a nice set.
